contract.precedence: This v3 preserves v1/v2 and supersedes them before any biological fitting or target effect scoring. It exactly binds the existing metadata-only prepared selections; no biological roles, doses, time, measured gene mask, optimization settings or endpoints were selected by outcomes.

scope.question: Does adding two rabbits as training-only data improve known-LPS predictions for held-out human donors, relative to human-base training, a matched additional-human reference, and a rabbit baseline-only target control?
scope.pig_exclusion_reason: Three complete courses contain two biological individuals plus one technical replicate; exact course-to-individual mapping is unresolved.
scope.historical_negative_evidence: Preserve all prior negative and null-failing State/Parse/mouse/TG evidence and prior measurement-assisted evidence with their original scope. This experiment does not replace or revise them.

rabbit.donor_selection_rule: Sort SHA256(UTF8(salt + | + donor_id)); take first two; do not replace by performance.
rabbit.interpretation: The source contrast includes LPS exposure and culture-time differences; it does not isolate the causal effect of LPS.

gene_interface.axis_order: ascending integer state_index in original native checkpoint coordinates
gene_interface.mapping_rule: exact stable Ensembl IDs; unique high-confidence one-to-one human-rabbit orthologues; observed in both raw matrices; no expression-driven selection
gene_interface.input_support: All primary arms use exactly the same 4633 measured native coordinates. Other native input coordinates are computationally zero-filled and flagged excluded/unobserved for this experiment.
gene_interface.loss_support: All training losses and all biological metrics select only the same 4633 observed coordinates. No excluded coordinate contributes as an observed zero.
gene_interface.native_architecture: Retain full 6546-coordinate pretrained gene layers, their weights at initialization, and full intermediate pathways, including final_down_then_up. No sliced, reinitialized or species-specific random gene head. Shared connected parameters may change under the specified fine-tuning.
gene_interface.latent_unscored_coordinates: Intermediate values on excluded output coordinates remain latent pretrained-path values without measured-expression interpretation.

normalization.order: Compute coding library denominator on the complete observed coding universe before selecting 4633 shared model coordinates.
normalization.reference_source: Pinned Hagai author Ensembl84 coding lists, exact stable-ID join to each measured axis; human GRCh38 coding annotation is joined by stable ID to the hg19 measured feature axis.
normalization.zero_coding_library_rule: Abort preflight and report affected cell IDs; do not silently drop cells or change the panel.
normalization.historical_checkpoint_scale: Not fully recovered. This normalization is an explicit new-assay transfer adaptation.

model.initialization: Each fold/arm independently reconstructs the same strictly loaded official checkpoint and zero-initialized extension. No pooled-human warm-up or cross-fold trained state is reused.
model.readout_order: Subtract the two native outputs before adding C to preserve exact zero-step cancellation.
model.mode_during_optimization: eval with autograd enabled; dropout disabled in both forwards
model.native_outputs: Save separately where needed for diagnostics; all primary outputs use the frozen anchored/clamped readout.
model.zero_step_prediction: Exactly C under the identical observation mask.
model.pretraining_scope: The retained checkpoint was pretrained on its original human HepG2 genetic-perturbation dataset. Historical preprocessing is incompletely recovered. This new human PBMC/rabbit LPS experiment uses a derived contrast adaptation and does not establish unseen-perturbation or raw native zero-shot compatibility.

splitting.donor_hash_algorithm: SHA256 of UTF8(salt + | + full_donor_id), ascending hex digest, full donor ID tiebreak
splitting.excluded_target_rna: All RNA from the two target donors is excluded from that fold training and calibration. Target baseline is allowed only for frozen-model inference. Target LPS is read only after the global prediction freeze.
splitting.cross_fold_label_use: A person can train another outer fold under this fixed nested design. No cross-fold biological summary or human discretionary selection is permitted before all predictions freeze.
splitting.base_order_rule: Role memberships follow the five-pair rotation. Within base role, preserve original metadata-selected global donor hash order recorded in frozen selections.json; the 200-step donor cycle follows this recorded order in every arm.

cell_budgets.source_matching: For each ordered extra-human donor, its paired rabbit supplies exactly min(128,N_extra_control) unique control cells and N_extra_LPS unique 6h LPS cells. Match two independent source donors per arm.
cell_budgets.cell_pool_rule: Within each donor/condition use SHA256(UTF8(namespace + | + full_cell_id)) with namespace=cell_order/human or cell_order/rabbit, ascending digest then fullcellID. Pools and row indices are fixed in selections.json before model fitting.
cell_budgets.rabbit_a0: Use identical real-rabbit input control C. Reserve a globally disjoint Cprime block after max selected control count over all five folds for that rabbit (rabbit2 offset124,rabbit1 offset128). Take the first N_extra_LPS Cprime cells for that fold. No source input cell is reused as an A0 target in any fold.
cell_budgets.independent_sample_accounting: Count unique donors and cell IDs. Repeated SGD exposure never increases the unique sample budget.
cell_budgets.test_control_identity: All arms and checkpoints use the identical complete author-QC target baseline pool; response subtraction uses the mean of that same pool.

arms.name: H+Rabbit
arms.training_data: same base-human donors plus rabbit2/rabbit1 real source contrasts

arms.name: H+Hextra
arms.training_data: same base-human donors plus two extra-human donors

arms.name: H+RabbitA0
arms.training_data: same base-human donors plus rabbit2/rabbit1 disjoint baseline-only false targets

training.objective_scope: MSE of population means; native energy is secondary evaluation only.

normalization.pool_rule: Use the full fixed selected training pools, before optimization; use only the four Hbase donors and the corresponding two true source donors in that fold.
normalization.a0_rule: H+RabbitA0 reuses the coefficient derived from real H+Rabbit source targets. Never estimate a separate scale from A0.
normalization.a0_information_retained: The real-source amplitude/loss-scale scalar is retained; real LPS target distributions and response directions are removed from A0 supervision.
normalization.extra_human_rule: Apply the identical formula using the two selected extra-human donors.
normalization.interpretation: Matched independent donor/cell budgets and fixed optimizer steps, with source-specific initial-loss scaling. Equal monetary cost or exact FLOP equality is not asserted.

parameter_policy.connected_shared_gene_layers_and_backbon: trainable from their retained pretrained values
parameter_policy.unused_original_perturbation_columns_and: preserve values using freezing or exact row restoration after AdamW; do not count decay-only movement as data learning
parameter_policy.disconnected_gene_decoder: retained in state_dict and excluded from optimizer
parameter_policy.old_shared_biases: trainable at core learning rate when connected

training.seed_rule: 20261110 + fold; same seed and schedules across all four arms

batch_schedule.cells_per_population: min(64, number of unique cells in its fixed pool)
batch_schedule.sampling: The fixed cell_pool hash order assigns zero-based positions to each selected population. At each step rank those positions by SHA256(UTF8(schedule_salt|fold_seed|step_index|population_key|pool_position)); select the first min(64,N) positions without replacement, then resolve to real cell IDs. Reuse across different steps is permitted.
batch_schedule.population_key: Human base uses donor ID and control/target role identically in every arm. Added-source arms use paired slot0/1 and control/target role, so matched populations of equal size have identical selected rank positions. Rabbit A and A0 share exact control IDs; source target ranks map to distinct true/false target pools.

training.forward_calls: Both condition forwards retain gradients. H computes only human objective; added arms also compute source objective.
training.failed_fit_rule: Record the failure; do not omit a fold, swap donors, extend budget or retune after outcomes. A complete primary result requires all 20 fits or explicit failure status.

inference.input_cells: all author-QC control cells for calibration and target inference, ordered by the fixed cell_pool hash; training controls alone are capped at128
inference.chunking: Consecutive chunks of at most 64 actual cells; final smaller chunk stays smaller. No cell repetition or zero-cell padding.
inference.chunk_aggregation: Concatenate real predicted cells; each input cell has weight one in the resulting population mean.
inference.observed_axis_only: Compute scored outputs on fixed 4633 coordinates.

calibration.allowed_labels: Only that fold calibration donor baseline and LPS labels
calibration.checkpoint_selection: For each arm, select candidate step minimizing arithmetic mean of the two unshrunk calibration donor primary MSE values.
calibration.checkpoint_tie_break: earliest step under exact numerical tie

post_calibration_shrink.procedure: After selecting each arm checkpoint, use that checkpoint calibration predictions to choose alpha minimizing equal-donor mean MSE. Apply the identical grid/rule to every arm.
post_calibration_shrink.tie_break: smallest alpha under exact numerical tie
post_calibration_shrink.test_application: Freeze each fold/arm alpha before any target scoring; apply once without reoptimization.
post_calibration_shrink.output_requirement: Report raw selected-checkpoint and selected-shrink diagnostics for all arms; report every selected alpha. No test-selected best-alpha reporting.

primary.name: donor_mean_response_mse
primary.donor_weight: equal across all ten target donors
primary.fold_weight: equal because every fold contains two target donors
primary.double_counting: Response MSE and treated-mean MSE are algebraically identical and are one endpoint.

secondary.name: native_energy
secondary.procedure: Use pinned official model _compute_distribution_loss on the observed 4633-coordinate P and T populations; mean its returned values; retain unequal real N/M. Log the exact pinned loss implementation and settings.

secondary.name: response_pearson
secondary.formula: Pearson correlation across genes between mean(P)-mean(C) and mean(T)-mean(C)
secondary.undefined_rule: NA when either response has zero variance; never replace undefined with zero

secondary.name: response_direction_cosine
secondary.undefined_rule: NA when either vector norm is zero

secondary.name: clamped_coordinate_fraction
secondary.formula: Fraction of observed cell-gene entries where C + f(C,LPS)-f(C,assay_control) is below zero before clamp

baselines.base_human_mean_response: For each of the four Hbase donors compute mean_selected_LPS-mean_selected_control; average those four vectors equally. Predict each target control cell as clamp_min(C + mean_Hbase_response,0), then aggregate.
baselines.calibrated_shrink: All-arm diagnostic defined above; H calibrated shrink is a prespecified nuisance benchmark.
baselines.source_access: The base-human mean-response baseline uses Hbase only.

metrics.percentage_rule: Difference between equally weighted donor-average MSEs divided by the same comparator donor-average MSE. Do not average donor percentage changes.
metrics.animal_human_gain_ratio: Report delta_A/delta_H only when delta_H>0; flag instability when delta_H is small, and label ratio descriptive. No replacement-equivalence or noninferiority claim.

prediction_freeze.scope: All five folds, all four selected-checkpoint models, all selected alpha values, all target predictions, all zero/mean/half/shrink baseline predictions, and manifests must be complete and hashed.
artifacts: training data and annotation SHA256 manifest
fold-specific selected cell ID lists and pool hashes
selected checkpoints or checkpoint weight hashes
all target prediction arrays and SHA256
prediction_freeze.scorer_isolation: The separate scoring entrypoint loads test LPS outcomes only after checking the global frozen manifest. It cannot optimize, modify masks, select cells, change alpha/checkpoints or omit donors.
prediction_freeze.storage: Large arrays remain remote. Local artifacts contain only compact audit and result records.

preflight_gates.mask: Verify identical 4633 support and full native 6546 architecture in every arm.
preflight_gates.coding_denominators: Verify pinned mask hashes, positive coding UMI denominator for every selected cell, and normalize before model-axis selection.
preflight_gates.initialization: Artificial-input checks verify identical original outputs after extension and exactly control-equal anchored initial predictions with eval mode.
preflight_gates.animal_gradient: Use a separate artificial-data scratch clone for three optimizer steps under the anchored MSE objective; record per-step gradients and updates. Step-one shared-gradient cancellation is expected. By step three, require finite nonzero data gradients in connected shared gene layers and backbone and a change in artificial human-context contrast predictions. Weight decay alone is insufficient. Never seed a biological run from the scratch clone.
preflight_gates.leakage: For each fold assert target donor IDs absent from training/calibration loaders; assert A0 input/target cell IDs disjoint; assert no query animal responses; assert no duplicated padding cells.
preflight_gates.fresh_starts: All biological arms start from the same freshly reconstructed official model and extension.
preflight_gates.fail_action: Abort and report the technical failure. Any repair must preserve this scientific contract and be separately logged; scientific changes require a new contract.

completed_three_step_probe.scope: Artificial inputs only; first-step shared cancellation and third-step shared data-gradient/updates verified before biology.

positive_candidate_gate: All 20 fits and all ten donor scores reported.
H+Rabbit mean primary MSE is lower than zero-response and Hbase-mean-response baselines.
At least 8 of 10 target donors improve relative to H, and all five paired-fold mean improvements are positive.

Each fold included in an animal-training claim uses a nonzero selected animal training step; a zero-step fold contributes no animal-training evidence. A result containing zero-step folds does not satisfy the strict all-fold positive-candidate gate.
A diagnostic claim based on selected shrink requires nonzero alpha in every cited fold; alpha zero is the zero-response predictor and supplies no animal-training evidence.
interpretation.gate_meaning: Prespecified descriptive stability screen, not a calibrated significance test. Report failures and negative findings without rescue retuning.
interpretation.statistical_unit: human donor; cells/genes do not increase biological N
interpretation.cross_validation_dependence: Overlapping training sets and shared within-fold models induce dependence. Naive independent-donor sign-flip, five-fold permutation, cell-level t-tests or confidence intervals ignoring training/selection uncertainty are not confirmatory.
interpretation.bootstrap: If supplied, donor bootstrap is explicitly descriptive conditional on these already-trained models and does not estimate retraining/selection uncertainty.
limitations: Single known LPS condition in one human study; no unseen-perturbation test.
Rabbit time, dose, tissue and study differ from human; species effects are confounded with those attributes.
Only two selected rabbit individuals contribute to primary training.
Historical HepG2 normalization is incompletely recovered; all arms are new-assay contrast adaptations.
Source-specific loss normalization preserves a real-LPS amplitude scalar in A0.
Fixed optimizer steps and matched source donor/cell budgets do not imply equal experimental monetary cost or exact compute cost.
interpretation.after_results: Preserve every old negative result and this v1 output. New seeds, data subsets, times, source species, objectives, model heads or budgets are separately named follow-up experiments with outcome-awareness disclosed.

compact_review_items: Protein-coding denominator provenance is now available: human19123/rabbit19293 observed coding genes; all4633 model genes lie in both coding masks.
The final objective is population-mean MSE with H+0.5*normalized-source; earlier review energy/two-slot suggestions are superseded.
Training control pools cap128; calibration and target inference use all author-QC control and LPS cells. The same complete control mean is used in every response subtraction.
A0 uses disjoint real baseline targets and inherits the real-rabbit scale scalar.
Use explicit three-step scratch-clone animal-gradient audit because shared gradients cancel at zero initialization.
All20 selected model predictions and all shrink choices freeze before the first target score.
Primary remains unshrunk selected-checkpoint output; all-arm calibrated shrink is a fixed diagnostic.

supersedes.reason: Executable review found metadata preparation used an explicit existing cell_order hash namespace, globally disjoint A0 offsets and globally hashed base order rather than three differing prose descriptions in v2. V3 adopts the already-frozen metadata choices; all role memberships, counts, variables and observations remain unchanged. No biological fit or target score has occurred.

prepared_manifest.scope: No fitting, model prediction, treatment-effect ranking, response-based selection, or outcome scores

primary_gene_axis.excluded_coordinates: Computational zero inputs only; never counted as observed target genes or scored

normalization.zero_coding_library_rule: abort entire preparation; do not drop cells
